{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders — now using cleaned revenue
df['is_qa'] = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA test orders after cleaning: {df[df['is_qa']].shape[0]}")

# List the QA order IDs
print(f"QA order IDs: {df[df['is_qa']]['order_id'].tolist()}")

# Confirm that QA orders were not present in original revenue string
print(f"Original revenue values for QA orders: {df[df['is_qa']]['revenue'].tolist()}")"}
